latest.title: A new layout: problems first, then five places to fix them
latest.summary: The board is rebuilt around what needs your attention. The Overview opens on Needs attention, each finding with a button that takes you to the exact setting, and a way back to where you were. The masthead has five places: the Overview, Businesses (results, cash and loans, prices against the market, a standards comparison with uniforms you can set from it, milestones), Supply (the changes to make, imports, deliveries, production and goods flow), Staffing (schedules, staff needs, payroll) and Expansion (demand, finding a location, planning a factory), with the City map and the Game guide beside them. Every business page links to its schedule, deliveries and prices. Changes you mark, apply through the game link, or that a later save confirms now look different, and preferences and help have their own panels under the ··· menu. Old links keep working.
